text:
Marco (AE): Heads up — Halcyon AI asking for a POC we need to price. Private deployment + data isolation requested. Their ask: 35% off list for a 6mo POC. If they like it they convert to dedicated commit. They want decision by EOD Fri. cc @Ellen (RevOps)

Ellen (RevOps): 35% is above typical POC concession. Quick context: our default POC playbook is up to 20% + onboarding fee. >25% requires VP signoff.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Tech note — private deploy means added infra & ops overhead. Rough estimate: incremental infra cost ~ $8k–$12k/mo for the POC shape they described (kv cache + dedicated nodes). Also ~2–3 days extra SRE time on setup and firewall/KMS integration. Could trim infra by quantizing but may affect LLM quality.

Priya (Finance): 35% looks high from a margin perspective. Need the margin calc before approving. For dedicated/private POCs we typically want either an onboarding fee or a minimum committed spend to protect economics. Suggestion: 20% + $25k onboarding + 3mo minimum billing.

Sam (Sales Eng): Security checklist: they sent a long security questionnaire; SecurityBot popped SOC2 report attached + standard network diagram. For private deploy we'll need customer-provided IP allowlist + KMS integration — that adds ~5 business days if docs are in place.

Marco (AE): Their counter is pressure from a competitor — they were quoted 30% + waived onboarding. If we don't do something stronger we risk losing deal. They also want a clause that if converted to a 12mo commit within 90 days the POC discount applies to month 1 of committed pricing.

Ellen (RevOps): Competing on price is tough. Alternative structure to protect us: offer 25% off list for the 6mo POC + $30k onboarding + explicit 3mo minimum billing and no SLA for POC. Add a conversion credit: if they convert to a 12mo committed plan within 90 days, apply a one-time rebate equal to 10% of POC invoices (not transferable). That reduces upfront concession while giving sales leverage.

Priya (Finance): That structure is acceptable to finance. Approve up to 25% with the onboarding fee and 3mo min. Anything >25% needs Monica (VP Rev) signoff. Need to see final margin calc and redlines before signature.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Implementation timeline with that approach: kick + 2 weeks for infra + 1 week for security review if they provide docs promptly. I'll prep a simplified runbook and cost appendix to include in the SOW.

Marco (AE): OK — I'll pitch 25% + $30k onboarding + 3mo min + conversion rebate to the customer and try to get them to accept. If they push for deeper discount I'll escalate. Meeting with buyer tomorrow 2pm.

Monica (VP Rev): Quick note — I won't sign >30% for a POC without Executive sponsor confirmation and a guaranteed committed minimum post-POC. If you think conversion rates and strategic value justify >30%, include ARR forecast and exec sponsor details.

Marco (AE): Understood. I'll send the ARR projection and customer exec champion info to you after the call.

Ellen (RevOps): Final ask: include these contract bullets in the SOW draft I can approve: 1) 6mo POC term, 2) 3mo min billing, 3) onboarding fee $30k, 4) no SLA for POC, 5) conversion rebate clause (10% of POC invoices) if commit within 90 days. If Monica signs off for higher discount we attach finance-approved margin calc.

Priya (Finance): I'll review the margin calc when Marco shares numbers. Tag me for final approval. :thumbsup:

Sam (Sales Eng): I'll expedite the security docs to the customer and mark the questionnaire as 'expedite' so they can return it faster.

Marco (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll update after the 2pm call and drop the SOW draft into the shared folder. :rocket:

SecurityBot: Attached: SOC2-report.pdf, standard-network-diagram.png (accessed).
